name: possiblaw-plugins
description: PossibLaw plugin marketplace: the PossibNow Dev Harness (a two-tier progressive governance harness for non-developer builders, Claude + Codex), plus a legal-app design grill.

plugins.name: possibnow-dev-harness
plugins.description: PossibNow Dev Harness: two-tier progressive governance harness (Claude + Codex). Tier 1 (Starter): PLAN/TEST/REVIEW/HANDOFF pipeline, one shared .agent/HANDOFF.md that every commit must carry (Claude Code guardrail), runtime guardrails, simplicity ladder, and token discipline. Tier 2 (Scale): Graphify indexing queried instead of re-reading source, gated by /possibnow-dev-harness:scale as the codebase grows. Cross-tool via AGENTS.md; macOS + Linux.

plugins.name: possiblaw-vibe
plugins.description: Legal-app design grill in the spirit of Matt Pocock's grill-me skill. Walks document systems, software systems, workflows, data model, and integrations through relentless interrogation until the spec is real.
